items.title: John E. Wood Interview, 1986-06-26
items.q: Aha, how clever Dick Allen is that he has gotten in by assuming this official role... And so we eventually got somebody... Bill Russell gathered you and I think Ida and I followed along with you.

ctx.x: Maybe he worked in churches playing music or something. Did you ever see any, uh, drunks at, at, uh, parades? Sure.

Uh, there would, there would be drunks at parades. Uh, this one we talked about, uh, over on Hamburg Street. But, uh, I remember there was somebody who was, uh, followed along and got noisy. And, uh, somebody would, you know, get him to go back up on the porch. But pretty soon he'd be back down again yelling. And, uh, he wasn't really disruptive. But I, I, as, I always felt, Dick, whenever, uh, never really got over this. That when we went to those parades, you met, you were a white person going into a black…
